en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father who said,
‘Ali Bin Hassan said to Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, ‘O my Master<sup>asws</sup>! The people are denying upon you<sup>asws</sup> because of your young age’.

So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘And what are they denying from that, the Words of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic? Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Said to His<sup>azwj</sup> Prophet<sup>saww</sup>
[12:108] Say: This is my way: I call to Allah, I and the one who follows me having insight.
So, by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, none followed him<sup>saww</sup> except for Ali<sup>asws</sup>, and for him<sup>asws</sup> were nine years, and I<sup>asws</sup> am a boy of nine years old’.
en.sarwar: 8. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father who has said the following. “Once abu Ali ibn Hassa’n spoke to abu Ja‘far (a.s.) saying, “My mater, people refuse to accept your Imamat (Leadership with Divine Authority) because of you very young age.”

He said, “Why do they not refuse to accept the words of Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most gracious. Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most gracious, has said to His prophet, “ (Muhammad), say, “This is my way. I and all my followers invite you to God with proper understanding.. .” [12:108]
By Allah, only Ali (a.s.) followed him at that time and he was only nine years old. I also am nine years old.
